## v1.36.0

GenUI widgets now render the nested, multi-line content the agent sends. Nothing is removed, but a few renderer outputs change shape (see Behavior change), so check hosts that read descriptors directly.

### Added

- `video-gallery` reads `citation.clips` and `clips`. Each video has `startTime` and `endTime` in seconds (`null` when absent), and `video_link` works as a url alias.
- `flashcards` reads `keypoints` (title is the front, summary is the back) and keeps each card's clips as `card.clips`.
- `content-gallery` items have `type` and `clips`. A video slide gets a play button and the first clip fills `imageUrl` and `url`.
- `sources` keep `entryId`, `type`, `duration` and `hasShort` when the widget sends them.
- `summary` has `chapters`, a list of strings shown as an ordered list by `mountWidget`.
- `video-tool` (and `video`) render as `external-video`. `GENUI_RUNTIMES` is unchanged.
- The `play` action payload has `startTime` and `endTime`.

### Fixed

- `parseContent` reads nested lists, `|` and `>` block scalars, multi-line and escaped quoted strings and flow `[]` and `{}`, so keypoints, slides and clips no longer fall into `.raw`.

### Behavior change

- `content-gallery` descriptions keep their line breaks. `mountWidget` shows them as spaces.
- `content-gallery` drops items that have no id, title, text, image, link or clips.
- `parseContent` no longer reads `key:value` (no space after the colon) as a key. It goes to `.raw`.
- The `summary` descriptor always has `chapters` (an empty list when none).
- A renderer registered as `video` now replaces the `external-video` renderer, because `video` is an alias.
- `onAgentAction` sees `runtime: 'external-video'` for a `video-tool` widget.

### Docs

- The GenUI widget reference lists the new fields and a shared clip table.
